How I See
Colors.

Photography · Personal project · 2025

A photo project about the colors I keep coming back to.

Color isn't objective. Two people look at the same sky and describe it differently. So I went to the Cinque Terre to photograph the colors I couldn't stop noticing. Franco Fontana got me into this years ago — this was me trying to actually see again.
